verdict.rationale: Vendor docs repeatedly claim CAPTCHA solving, login handling, and form-wall bypass are built-in ('When your workflow requires a form, a CAPTCHA, or a login prompt, it's handled'; 'Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included'), aligning directly with the story. However, all evidence is vendor-authored marketing/docs with no independent or hands-on verification of reliability across real-world anti-bot challenges.
